description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the nursing team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This pivotal leadership role offers an exciting opportunity to oversee all nursing operations, ensuring the delivery of exceptional patient care and maintaining high standards of clinical excellence. The ideal candidate will be a compassionate leader with a strong commitment to quality and a passion for making a difference in the lives of residents.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be instrumental in fostering a positive and supportive environment for both staff and residents. You will guide and mentor your team, implement best practices, and ensure compliance with all regulatory standards. This role is perfect for a visionary nursing professional ready to take on a challenging yet rewarding position with a competitive annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in a nursing leadership role, such as DON or ADON
Prior experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 based on experience.
